Q: The proper way to use marked.js with the Vue/React components A:

Vue component inside marked
I ran into the same problem. The best solution I've come up with so far is
For each custom component render a placeholder then later uses Vue's built-in <Teleport> .

  • About <Teleport>

    <Teleport> is a built-in component that allows us to "teleport" a part of a component's template into a DOM node that exists outside the DOM hierarchy of that component. https://vuejs.org/guide/built-ins/teleport

The rendering flow is:

  1. marked renders Markdown to HTML.

  2. A custom renderer replaces supported elements with placeholder nodes (with random id for teleport to work) and records the corresponding Vue component.

  3. Once rendering completes, Vue renders <Teleport> the recorded components.

  4. Each <Teleport> mounts its Vue component into the matching placeholder.

Any help is welcome!

Q: Calculating exact fraction of months during period A:

If you need an exact fraction of months instead of whole months, calculate the number of days between the two dates and divide by the actual number of days in the relevant month (or use an average month length if that's acceptable). The best approach depends on whether you want calendar-month precision or a financial/month-average calculation
